evidence: Significantly modifies wallet spending routines in src/wallet/spend.cpp, coin selection, fee bumping, wallet database records, and wallet RPCs to support BIP 352 destinations.
rationale: Adds wallet and RPC support for sending transactions to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses, providing substantial user-facing value for receiver privacy and address reuse prevention. Tracked under project issue #28536 and unblocks follow-on work #32966, making it a strategically important wallet milestone deserving deliberate review.
